tagline.zh: 從門口到氣球，時鐘不停
tagline.en: From door to balloon, the clock never stops

desc.zh: 導管室的第二位術者、急診電話的第一個接聽者。你判讀心電圖、啟動導管室、穿刺、算風險分數。
desc.en: Second operator in the cath lab and first to answer the ED phone. You read the ECG, activate the lab, puncture, and work out the risk scores.

desc.zh: C 臂是你的。投照角度、輻射劑量、鉛衣、顯影劑紀錄，還有在門球時間裡每一秒都準備好的那台機器。
desc.en: The C-arm is yours: projection angles, radiation dose, lead aprons, the contrast log, and a machine that is ready every second of the door-to-balloon clock.

about.zh: 脖子上掛著一個碼表。口頭禪：「門球時間從病人進門開始，不是從你看到他開始。」
about.en: Wears a stopwatch round his neck. Catchphrase: 'Door-to-balloon starts when the patient comes through the door, not when you see him.'

about.zh: 導管、導絲、氣球、支架，她遞的永遠是對的那一支。
about.en: Catheters, wires, balloons, stents: she always hands you the right one.

role.zh: 病人：預約冠狀動脈攝影

about.zh: 五十八歲計程車司機，爬坡會胸悶。最擔心的是右手：「我靠這隻手吃飯。」
about.en: Fifty-eight, taxi driver, chest tightness on hills. His biggest worry is his right hand: 'I earn my living with this hand.'

about.zh: 六十六歲，糖尿病。沒有胸痛，只有上腹悶和冒冷汗。她以為是早餐吃壞了。
about.en: Sixty-six, diabetic. No chest pain, just upper abdominal heaviness and a cold sweat. She thought it was breakfast.

about.zh: 七十二歲，心房顫動在吃抗凝血劑。半夜胸悶兩次，肌鈣蛋白上升，心電圖沒有 ST 上升。
about.en: Seventy-two, atrial fibrillation on an anticoagulant. Two episodes of chest tightness overnight, rising troponin, no ST elevation.

about.zh: 救護車的心電圖一傳進來，他就打給你。從不等肌鈣蛋白。
about.en: The moment the ambulance ECG comes through, he calls you. Never waits for the troponin.

about.zh: 夜班。聽診器永遠掛在脖子上，聽到新的雜音就打電話。
about.en: Night shift. Stethoscope always round her neck; a new murmur and she dials.

plain.zh: 病人進急診大門到阻塞血管被氣球打通的時間。越短，救回的心肌越多。
plain.en: From the patient entering the hospital door to the blocked artery being opened with a balloon. The shorter, the more heart muscle saved.

plain.zh: 手腕上摸得到脈搏的那條動脈。從這裡進入做心導管，出血少、可以早點下床。
plain.en: The artery you feel at the wrist. Going in here for a heart catheter means less bleeding and earlier mobilisation.

plain.zh: 放在動脈裡的短管，有單向閥，導管和導絲從這裡進出。
plain.en: A short tube with a one-way valve left in the artery, through which catheters and wires pass.

plain.zh: 注射進血管讓 X 光看得見血流的藥水。腎功能不好的人要先評估、要算用量。
plain.en: A fluid injected into vessels so X-rays can see the blood flow. Patients with poor kidneys need assessment first and a careful tally.

plain.zh: 造成這次心肌梗塞的那條阻塞血管。急性期先處理它，其他的之後再說。
plain.en: The blocked artery causing this infarct. Treat it first in the acute phase; the rest can wait.

plain.zh: 心電圖上某幾個導程的 ST 段抬高，代表那個區域的心肌正在因為缺氧而壞死。
plain.en: A raised ST segment in a group of ECG leads, meaning that region of heart muscle is dying from lack of blood.

plain.zh: 把胸前電極貼到右胸再照一次心電圖，看右心室有沒有一起梗塞。下壁梗塞一定要加做。
plain.en: Chest electrodes moved to the right side for a second ECG to see whether the right ventricle is involved. Mandatory in an inferior infarct.

plain.zh: 阻塞的血管重新打通，血流回到心肌。那一刻常常伴隨心律變化。
plain.en: The blocked artery reopened and blood returning to the muscle. The moment is often accompanied by rhythm changes.

plain.zh: 用年齡、心跳、血壓、腎功能等算出來的風險分數，決定非 ST 上升心肌梗塞多快要做心導管。
plain.en: A risk score from age, pulse, pressure, kidney function and more, deciding how urgently a non-ST-elevation infarct needs a catheter.

plain.zh: 兩種讓血小板不容易黏在一起的藥一起吃，保護支架不被血塊塞住。
plain.en: Two drugs that stop platelets clumping, taken together to protect the stent from clotting.

plain.zh: 導管室裡每個人穿的防護衣。X 光開著的時候，沒有鉛衣就沒有人。
plain.en: The protective garment everyone in the lab wears. When the X-ray is on, no apron means no person.

plain.zh: 拔掉橈動脈鞘管後，止血帶壓到剛好不出血、但血還流得過去。保護這條動脈以後還能用。
plain.en: After the radial sheath comes out, the band is tightened just enough to stop bleeding while flow continues, so the artery stays usable.

plain.zh: 心肌梗塞後心臟的結構破掉：乳頭肌、心室中隔、游離壁。新的雜音加血壓掉，就要想它。
plain.en: A structural rupture after an infarct: papillary muscle, septum or free wall. A new murmur with falling pressure means think of it.

plain.zh: 聽診器聽到的額外聲音。心肌梗塞後新出現的雜音，是警報，不是雜訊。
plain.en: An extra sound through the stethoscope. A murmur that is new after an infarct is an alarm, not noise.

text.zh: 一個 C 形的 X 光機，繞著病人轉。每一個角度都是一張不同的心臟地圖。
text.en: A C-shaped X-ray machine that swings round the patient. Every angle is a different map of the heart.

text.zh: 導管、導絲、氣球、支架，一排排放好。鞘管放進去之後，時間就開始算。
text.en: Catheters, wires, balloons and stents laid out in rows. Once the sheath is in, the clock is running.

text.zh: X 光開著的時候穿。放射師會提醒你，第二次就會用喊的。
text.en: Worn whenever the X-ray is on. The radiographer will remind you; the second time, loudly.

text.zh: 玻璃後面：影像、血行動力、輻射劑量、顯影劑用量。放射師在這裡看著一切。
text.en: Behind the glass: images, haemodynamics, radiation dose, contrast volume. The radiographer watches everything from here.

text.zh: 進門、心電圖、啟動、進導管室、穿刺、氣球。六個時間，一條線。
text.en: Door, ECG, activation, lab arrival, puncture, balloon. Six times, one line.

text.zh: 透明的腕帶，一點一點放鬆。他握著方向盤的那隻手要保住。
text.en: A clear wristband loosened step by step. The hand that holds the steering wheel must be kept.

text.zh: 每一分鐘的阻塞都在殺死心肌細胞。導管室的每一個流程，都是為了省那幾分鐘。
text.en: Every minute of blockage kills heart muscle. Every step in the cath lab exists to save those minutes.

lines.zh: 白板：08:00 阿明，預約冠狀動脈攝影，橈動脈。下午老李從急診上來。角落寫著「STEMI 隨時」。
lines.en: Board: 08:00 Mr Ming, elective coronary angiography, radial. Mr Lee up from the ED this afternoon. In the corner: 'STEMI any time'.

lines.zh: 早。導管桌開好了。唐主治的碼表已經掛在脖子上了，雖然還沒有病人。
lines.en: Morning. The table is set. Dr Tang already has the stopwatch round his neck, though there is no patient yet.

lines.zh: 早。阿明為什麼走橈動脈，不走股動脈？
lines.en: Morning. Why radial for Mr Ming and not femoral?

lines.zh: 出血少、可以早下床。但要先確認橈動脈和側枝循環。
lines.en: Less bleeding, earlier mobilisation. But the radial artery and its collateral supply must be checked first.

lines.zh: 對。他靠那隻手吃飯，你穿刺前要比他更在意那隻手。
lines.en: Right. He earns his living with that hand; before you puncture, care about it more than he does.

lines.zh: 開機、影像品質測試、劑量紀錄歸零、鉛衣掛好、甲狀腺護頸數夠。
lines.en: Power up, image-quality test, dose log zeroed, lead aprons hung, enough thyroid collars.

q.zh: 點選 C 臂，完成每日檢查。
q.en: Tap the C-arm to complete the daily check.

lines.zh: 醫師，這隻手會不會壞掉？我開車三十年了。
lines.en: Doctor, will this hand be damaged? I have driven for thirty years.

lines.zh: 我們先確認手掌有兩條血管在供血。壓住一條，看另一條夠不夠。
lines.en: First we confirm the hand has two arteries feeding it. Press one and see whether the other is enough.

post.zh: 側枝循環良好。這隻手我們會保住。
post.en: Good collateral supply. We will keep this hand.

note.zh: 阿明的冠狀動脈攝影完成

lines.zh: 從評估到鞘管，順序你排。每一步都有理由。
lines.en: From assessment to sheath: you put the steps in order. Each has a reason.

q.zh: 橈動脈心導管，穿刺前的順序？
q.en: Radial catheterisation: order the steps before the sheath goes in.

steps.zh: 評估橈動脈與側枝循環
steps.en: Assess the radial artery and collaterals

steps.zh: 超音波導引局部麻醉與穿刺
置入鞘管，橈動脈藥物依醫囑
steps.en: Insert the sheath; radial cocktail per protocol

lines.zh: 導管到主動脈根部了。打顯影劑之前，先告訴我你要看哪幾條血管。
lines.en: Catheter at the aortic root. Before the contrast, tell me which arteries you are looking for.

question.zh: 左冠狀動脈主幹分成哪兩條主要分支？右冠狀動脈供應哪裡？
question.en: The left main divides into which two major branches, and what does the right coronary supply?

answer.zh: 左前降支與左迴旋支。右冠狀動脈多數人供應下壁和右心室，也常供應房室結，所以下壁梗塞容易心跳變慢。
answer.en: The left anterior descending and the left circumflex. The right coronary usually supplies the inferior wall and right ventricle, and often the AV node, which is why inferior infarcts slow the heart.

post.zh: 左前降支中段有一處明顯狹窄，其他血管還好。
post.en: A significant stenosis in the mid left anterior descending; the other vessels are reasonable.

post.zh: 穩定型心絞痛，一條血管。先跟他談，不要急著放支架。
post.en: Stable angina, single vessel. Talk to him first; no rush to stent.

lines.zh: 你在控制室記下總透視時間、劑量面積乘積和顯影劑用量，提醒台上：「鉛衣，唐主治，你的護頸歪了。」
lines.en: In the control room you log the fluoroscopy time, the dose-area product and the contrast volume, and remind the table: 'Lead apron, Dr Tang; your collar is crooked.'

lines.zh: （扶正護頸）謝謝。
lines.en: (straightening the collar) Thank you.

lines.zh: 阿明，檢查做完了。鞘管拔掉，手腕上這條止血帶會一點一點放鬆。這叫專利止血：止血，但血還流得過。
lines.en: Mr Ming, the test is done. The sheath comes out and this wristband loosens step by step. Patent haemostasis: no bleeding, but the flow continues.

lines.zh: 那我今天下午可以開車嗎？
lines.en: So can I drive this afternoon?

lines.zh: 今天不行。明天再握方向盤。
lines.en: Not today. The steering wheel tomorrow.

note.zh: 張阿姨的罪犯血管打通

sub.zh: 救護車心電圖：下壁 ST 上升

lines.zh: 心臟內科嗎？救護車傳來的心電圖，二、三、aVF ST 上升。六十六歲女性，糖尿病，沒有胸痛，上腹悶加冒冷汗。八分鐘到。
lines.en: Cardiology? Ambulance ECG shows ST elevation in II, III and aVF. Sixty-six-year-old woman, diabetic, no chest pain, upper abdominal heaviness and sweating. Eight minutes out.

post.zh: 你要我現在啟動導管室，還是等她到了再說？
post.en: Do you want me to activate the lab now, or wait until she arrives?

q.zh: 到院前心電圖符合 STEMI，病人沒有胸痛。你怎麼做？
q.en: Pre-hospital ECG meets STEMI criteria; the patient has no chest pain. What do you do?

options.zh: 現在啟動導管室，一通電話
options.en: Activate the cath lab now, one call

why.zh: 糖尿病女性常常沒有典型胸痛。心電圖已經夠了，等肌鈣蛋白只是在燒心肌。
why.en: Diabetic women often have no typical chest pain. The ECG is enough; waiting for troponin burns muscle.

options.zh: 等她到了，再做一張心電圖和肌鈣蛋白
options.en: Wait for arrival, repeat the ECG and a troponin

why.zh: 每一分鐘都是心肌。碼表會記得這個決定。
why.en: Every minute is muscle. The stopwatch will remember this decision.

options.zh: 先請急診給藥觀察再說
options.en: Ask the ED to give drugs and observe

why.zh: 藥不會打通血管。再灌注的方法是導管室。
why.en: Drugs do not open the artery. Reperfusion means the cath lab.

post.zh: （按下碼表）門球時間從她進門開始。走。
post.en: (starting the stopwatch) Door-to-balloon time starts when she comes through the door. Go.

lines.zh: 醫師，我真的沒有心臟痛，是胃。早餐的油條……
lines.en: Doctor, it really is not my heart, it is my stomach. The fried dough at breakfast...

lines.zh: 張阿姨，有時候心臟痛起來就像胃。我們先貼心電圖，胸前導程加右側。
lines.en: Mrs Chang, sometimes the heart hurts like the stomach. ECG first, chest leads plus the right side.

post.zh: 下壁 ST 上升確認，右側導程也有抬高：右心室梗塞。輸液要小心，血壓藥要小心。
post.en: Inferior ST elevation confirmed, and the right-sided leads are up too: right ventricular infarct. Careful with fluids, careful with pressure-lowering drugs.

post.zh: 右側導程是你加的。好。上台。
post.en: You added the right-sided leads. Good. On the table.

lines.zh: 右冠狀動脈近端完全阻塞。罪犯血管就是它。導絲越過去，你來。
lines.en: Proximal right coronary, completely occluded. That is the culprit. Wire across; your hands.

lines.zh: 氣球打開，血流回來了。監視器上心跳突然掉下來，張阿姨說她頭暈。
lines.en: The balloon opens and flow returns. On the monitor the heart rate suddenly drops; Mrs Chang says she feels faint.

options.zh: 檢查血壓與意識、依醫囑處理、準備經皮節律
options.en: Check pressure and consciousness, treat per protocol, pacing pads ready

why.zh: 下壁與右心室梗塞再灌注時常見心跳變慢。多數會自己恢復，但要準備好。
why.en: Bradycardia is common when an inferior or right-ventricular infarct reperfuses. Most recover on their own, but be ready.

why.zh: 氣球已經洩了，血流回來才是心跳變慢的原因。不要把剛打通的血管再關起來。
why.en: The balloon is already down; returning flow is the cause. Do not re-close the artery you just opened.

why.zh: 右心室梗塞要小心輸液，但現在的問題是心律，不是容量。
why.en: Fluids matter in a right-ventricular infarct, but the problem right now is rhythm, not volume.

post.zh: 一分鐘後心跳回來了。張阿姨說：「……胃好像不悶了。」
post.en: A minute later the rate recovers. Mrs Chang says: '...My stomach feels better.'
(stopping the stopwatch) Balloon time. Write it down.

lines.zh: 進門、心電圖、啟動、進導管室、穿刺、氣球。六個時間。你看啟動那一格。
lines.en: Door, ECG, activation, lab arrival, puncture, balloon. Six times. Look at the activation box.

lines.zh: 啟動晚了。我在等她到。
lines.en: Activation was late. I waited for her to arrive.

lines.zh: 那十幾分鐘是心肌。下一次，到院前心電圖就是啟動的理由。
lines.en: Those minutes were muscle. Next time the pre-hospital ECG is the reason to activate.

lines.zh: 進門、心電圖、啟動、進導管室、穿刺、氣球。六個時間。啟動在她進門之前。
lines.en: Door, ECG, activation, lab arrival, puncture, balloon. Six times. Activation came before she was through the door.

lines.zh: 一通電話，導管室就醒了。
lines.en: One call and the lab was awake.

lines.zh: 對。這一欄是整張表最重要的一格。
lines.en: Yes. That box is the most important on the whole sheet.

lines.zh: 你把兩台的顯影劑用量和輻射劑量填進紀錄。張阿姨有糖尿病，腎功能要追蹤。
lines.en: You log contrast and radiation dose for both cases. Mrs Chang is diabetic; her kidney function needs follow-up.

note.zh: 老李的風險分層與時機確定

guide.en: Mr Lee up from the ED

sub.zh: 老李準備上來，第二次肌鈣蛋白上升
sub.en: Mr Lee on his way up; second troponin rising

lines.zh: 醫師，我沒有像隔壁那位那麼嚴重吧？心電圖說沒有那個什麼上升。
lines.en: Doctor, I am not as bad as the lady next door, am I? The ECG said no 'elevation' or whatever.

lines.zh: 沒有 ST 上升，但肌鈣蛋白在上升。我們要算一個分數，決定多快做心導管。
lines.en: No ST elevation, but the troponin is rising. We work out a score to decide how soon you need the catheter.

post.zh: GRACE 評分高。還有一件事：他在吃抗凝血劑。出血風險也要算。
post.en: High GRACE score. One more thing: he is on an anticoagulant. The bleeding risk counts too.

post.zh: 雙重抗血小板加抗凝血，三種藥一起，時間要盡量短。侵入性時機：二十四小時內。
post.en: Dual antiplatelet therapy plus the anticoagulant, three drugs together: keep that as short as possible. Invasive timing: within twenty-four hours.

post.zh: 那我明天可以吃早餐嗎？
post.en: So can I have breakfast tomorrow?

post.zh: 明天早上做完再吃，老李。
post.en: After the procedure tomorrow, Mr Lee.

guide.zh: 寫老李的抗栓與時機計畫

lines.zh: 你寫下：GRACE 評分高、出血風險高、抗凝血劑繼續依醫囑、雙重抗血小板時程、明早橈動脈心導管、腎功能與顯影劑預防。
lines.en: You write: high GRACE score, high bleeding risk, anticoagulant continued per protocol, dual antiplatelet schedule, radial catheter tomorrow morning, kidney function and contrast precautions.

note.en: Handed over to the night team

guide.en: Hand over to the night team

lines.zh: 阿明：左前降支單一狹窄，先藥物治療與討論，橈動脈止血帶已移除，手溫暖有脈搏。
lines.en: Mr Ming: single LAD stenosis, medical therapy and discussion first, radial band off, hand warm with a pulse.

lines.zh: 張阿姨：右冠狀動脈 STEMI 併右心室梗塞，支架已置，再灌注時心跳變慢已恢復，冠心加護病房。注意新雜音。
lines.en: Mrs Chang: RCA STEMI with right-ventricular involvement, stented, reperfusion bradycardia resolved, in the CCU. Watch for a new murmur.

lines.zh: 老李：NSTE-ACS，GRACE 評分高，明早心導管，抗凝血與雙重抗血小板依醫囑。
lines.en: Mr Lee: NSTE-ACS, high GRACE score, catheter tomorrow morning, anticoagulant and dual antiplatelet therapy per protocol.

lines.zh: 今天哪一個病人最不像心臟病？
lines.en: Which patient today looked least like a heart patient?

lines.zh: 張阿姨。她說是胃。
lines.en: Mrs Chang. She said it was her stomach.

lines.zh: 對。心電圖不會管病人說什麼。碼表也不會。回家吧。
lines.en: Yes. The ECG does not care what the patient says. Neither does the stopwatch. Go home.

sub.zh: 張阿姨有新的雜音，血壓偏低
sub.en: Mrs Chang has a new murmur and a low-ish pressure

lines.zh: 醫師，張阿姨心尖有一個新的收縮期雜音，下午沒有。血壓比傍晚低，她說有點喘。
lines.en: Doctor, Mrs Chang has a new systolic murmur at the apex that was not there this afternoon. Pressure lower than this evening and she feels a little breathless.

lines.zh: 心肌梗塞後新的心雜音是警報。我馬上到，請把超音波推到床邊。
lines.en: A new heart murmur after an infarct is an alarm. On my way; please bring the echo machine to the bedside.

lines.zh: （電話中）五個區都聽，配合頸動脈脈搏分收縮期和舒張期。然後告訴我雜音傳到哪裡。
lines.en: (on the phone) All five areas, timed against the carotid pulse to separate systole from diastole. Then tell me where it radiates.

post.zh: 心尖全收縮期雜音，傳到腋下。要想機械性併發症：乳頭肌。超音波現在做。
post.en: Pansystolic murmur at the apex radiating to the axilla. Think mechanical complication: papillary muscle. Echo now.

post.zh: 超音波醫師在路上，心臟外科我也先通知了。
post.en: The echo doctor is on the way and I have alerted cardiac surgery.

lines.zh: 超音波：輕度到中度的二尖瓣逆流，乳頭肌完整。血壓穩定了。張阿姨問油條還能不能吃。
lines.en: Echo: mild to moderate mitral regurgitation, papillary muscle intact. Pressure stable. Mrs Chang asks whether fried dough is still allowed.

lines.zh: （訊息）阿玉說你先聽診、再超音波、先通知外科。順序對。晚安，碼表我收起來了。
lines.en: (message) A-Yu says you auscultated first, then echo, and alerted surgery early. Right order. Good night; the stopwatch is back in the drawer.

sub.zh: 三條血管、一個碼表、一隻保住的手
sub.en: Three arteries, one stopwatch, one hand kept
